entities.name: Lady of Otaria
entities.description: An avatar from Dominara worshiped as a deity by the dwarves of Otaria and Sarpadia, born from a stone egg.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: The Lady's mother, who helped create and heal her.

entities.name: Fiers
entities.description: The Lady's father, who placed her stone egg among lava vents.

entities.name: Dwarves of Otaria and Sarpadia
entities.description: Dwarves created by the Lady to defend her world, who worship her.

entities.name: Themis
entities.description: One of three dwarves entrusted with the Lady's protection.

entities.name: Gardill
entities.description: One of three dwarves entrusted with the Lady's protection.

entities.name: Balthor Stoneface
entities.description: One of three dwarves entrusted with the Lady's protection.

entities.name: Demon despoilers
entities.description: Demons who attacked the world and created the goblins.

entities.name: Goblins
entities.description: Creatures made by the demon despoilers to undo the world's beauty.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War after which the Sarpadian dwarves' empire fell.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion during which the Lady may have been summoned a second time.

entities.name: Dominara
entities.description: The world the Lady was created to watch over.

events.summary: Gaea and Fiers create the Lady, who hatches from a giant stone egg heated among lava vents.
events.quote: The Lady was hatched from inside a giant stone egg that Fiers placed among lava vents to heat.

events.summary: Demon despoilers attack the world and create goblins; with Fiers's help the Lady creates the dwarves.
events.quote: With the help of Fiers, the Lady then created the dwarves to defend her world.

events.summary: The Lady and dwarves defeat the evil but she is gravely injured; Gaea heals her and Fiers encases her in half her egg.
events.quote: The Lady and the dwarves defeat the evil, but the Lady is grievously injured in the process.

events.summary: The gods entrust the Lady's protection to Themis, Gardill and Balthor Stoneface with a prophecy of three summonings.
events.quote: entrust the protection of the Lady to the three dwarves, Themis, Gardill, and Balthor Stoneface

events.summary: The Sarpadian dwarves summon the Lady to evacuate them to Terisiare after their empire falls.
events.quote: The first time her name was used was by the Sarpadian dwarves to evacuate them from Sarpadia to Terisiare

relations.quote: She has her mother Gaea ’s pearly, smooth, almost-translucent skin
her father Fiers ’s tall, athletic, well-toned body
